title: Estate Review Action Item Closure Rate
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=estate:review action_items_open=* action_items_total=*
| eval closure_pct=round(100*(action_items_total-action_items_open)/nullif(action_items_total,0),1)
| stats avg(closure_pct) as avg_closure, max(action_items_open) as max_open by review_type
| sort - max_open
description: Calculates average action-item closure percentage from estate review sessions by review type.
value: Open action items after attorney meetings mean recommendations never reached your binder or beneficiaries.
implementation: Capture `action_items_open` and `action_items_total` per review and track closure before the next session.
visualization: Bar chart of closure percentage by review type.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how much of your estate planning homework actually got done after each review.
